invariants.rationale: The method returns a HoodieWriteMetadata instance, which is expected to be non-null after an insert operation.
The records parameter is passed directly to the executor, so a null value would likely result in an exception, meaning it is expected to be non-null at method exit.
The getWriteStatuses method of HoodieWriteMetadata should return the List of WriteStatus objects, which should be non-null as part of a successful insert.
instantTime is required context for the insert, so it should be non-null at method exit.
A valid HoodieEngineContext is required to perform the insert operation.
